data.name: Azzhar
data.gender_notes: Azzhar is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'azhara', meaning to shine or be radiant. Azzhar is a beautiful and meaningful name for a baby boy, evoking images of light and brilliance. The name Azzhar carries the meaning “Radiant, Shining” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Azzhar usually hope their child will grow to embody radiant, shining and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the inner light of the soul, which shines brightly and illuminates the path towards spiritual growth and enlightenment.
data.etymology: Azzhar belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Radiant, Shining.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Azzhar total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
